info.title: Rich Presence
info.author: Flaming19
info.description: Plugin for showing Discord Rich Presence
info.details: This plugin works with an application running on a computer (Downloadable from https://github.com/FlamingNineteen/RichPresenceWUPS/releases) to update Discord Rich Presence with the Wii U game you are playing. This is done by sending info structured as json through UDP port 5005.\n\nMore information on the required computer app can be found in the plugin's configuration settings, or in the plugin's repository.

changelog:
v2.3
Wii U Plugin
- Some configuration options were changed:
    - Show controller count: Now has an option to display the party size based on the current app's support for the Gamepad.
    - Show network ID- and Show currently used network: Now has an option to display only if the game currently being played uses a network account.
- This version of the plugin is compatible with v2.2 of the client, but it's recommended that the client be updated as well.

 Discord App
- Command-line arguments were changed. To review the new arguments, read the Usage: https://github.com/FlamingNineteen/RichPresenceWUPS/releases/new section of the README.
- The client will now overwrite the Discord app's name (Wii U) with the name of the app currently being played. This frees up the details and state sections to be used for more information. Currently, it just says "Playing on the Wii U" and optionally your network ID, but in the future these lines could show information about the app by reading from the Wii U's memory.
- Some features were added to the Windows version:
    - By default, the app now runs in the background (27, 37). You can supply the -w, --windows-logs flag to see logs.
    - The app shows up in the tray menu (27, 37). Right-clicking the icon gives you some options:
        - The top title indicates the version.
        - The app checks for updates. On the first received message, it will indicate if an update to the client is recommended.
        - "Launch on Startup" can be toggled on to have the app automatically run on startup (13, 37).
        - "Quit Wii U Rich Presence" can be selected to quit the app.
    - Special thanks to @SelimGOZ and their fork: https://github.com/SelimGOZ/RichPresenceWUPS for providing a reference for how to implement the Windows API.
- The client will automatically attempt to reconnect if connection to Discord is lost (40)

v2.2
Wii U Plugin
Four new configuration options were added:
- Display full title: When enabled, shows the long title instead of the short title on your status.
- Primary title display language: Set the main language to show on Discord. If the title is not supported in the selected language, the title defaults to the first supported language (usually English).
- Only send data to a specific IP address: Toggle broadcasting to all local IPs or sending to a designated IP (as defined by the option below).
- IP address to send data to: Set the IP address to send data to when broadcasting is disabled.

Fixed a bug where disabling and re-enabling the plugin did not actually re-enable the plugin until a new application was loaded.

Also made the code far easier to read, with better documentation and naming conventions.

 Discord App
The update notification is now only shown on the app if updating is required by the plugin for all of its features to work properly. This was done because sometimes the latest version of the plugin does not always require the latest version of the PC app.

Fixed a bug where the Linux app was using an extraordinary amount of the CPU (59).

v2.11
Wii U Plugin
Rebuilt for the Aroma Beta 26 and WUPS 0.9.1 (48)

 Discord App
No changes

v2.1
Wii U Plugin
Four new configuration options were added:
- Enable or disable the plugin
- Choose whether or not to conform to Daylight Savings Time
- Change the UDP port number
- Enable or disable the plugin when playing Call of Duty games (43)


 Discord App
macOS builds are here! No longer do you have to manually compile the repository: you can expect macOS downloads in future releases.
A new command line argument was added. Type port followed by a number to change the default UDP port.
The program will now tell you if there is a new update.

v2.0
Wii U Plugin

Added an option to display an icon of the currently used network (Nintendo Network, Pretendo Network).
